question: Can V28 progressively restore joint headroom while targeting standing height under partial bearing at exposed prefix phase 248, then complete unchanged standing, settling and finite V56 walking?
rationale: The consumed R10AM diagnostic exhausted 600 raise commands with persistent nonfoot contact and joint-limit gate failures. R10AN identified near-limit targets and support-transfer obstacles; its hard 0.02-rad margin made most exposed poses infeasible. R10AO and the compiled R10AP kernel instead require per-joint nonworsening deficits and strict total deficit reduction whenever any joint lacks 0.02-rad headroom. Ranking prioritizes maximum deficit, then total deficit, then geometry cost. Standing height remains the objective under partial bearing. The verified native and reader paths retain 492 geometry-cost increases in 600 exposed inputs. These geometric and synthetic checks do not predict forces, tracking, fresh contacts or physical recovery.

Geometry cost may increase while the headroom rank improves; emit bounded joint targets only. Keep qualified support, actuator limits and all original task gates.

Record the exact reason. Never reuse a cached plan or change a deadline.
